implication_for_mv14: Bootstrap should quantify whether the approximate MV10 anchor pattern is stable under group-wise subject resampling.
MV14 should report uncertainty around anchor preservation, threshold DIF localization, and AIC/BIC model preference.
Use the MV13 R/mirt ladder as the default bootstrap refit family and keep all bootstrap rows local-only.
Convergence frequency must be a first-class result, not a hidden runtime detail.
Bootstrap should report selection frequencies and interval summaries rather than a single model winner.
Track only SE/CI availability counts and item-fit flag frequencies; keep parameter values local-only.
Bootstrap resampling unit is subject row within each dataset group, preserving original group sizes.
MV14 can strengthen measurement wording but cannot authorize full multimodal method work by itself.
Execution must version-capture the exact R/mirt bootstrap path and any fallback.
